change.reason: Preserve O4-4 task provenance and reject merchant results whose task lock is acquired after the deadline.
behaviorImpacts: New tasks record the locked creator identity_id; idempotent replay cannot renew or backfill it.
Task references are bounded, scoped, fresh read-only locators from confirmed creation or platform-accepted notification anchors.
Notification listing, claim and dequeued reads require current binding generation, customer/order ownership and the original route.
Strict task reference reads match exact task ID and binding; legacy NULL identity rows cannot become automatic references or notifications.
Explicit order queries retain prior access rules; old approvals/refund state are not revoked by reference expiry.
Startup readiness checks the required identity_id column before starting CLI/QQ processing.
Result acceptance uses the database UTC time at the conditional UPDATE after acquiring the task row lock in the same transaction; completed_at is not commit time.
